# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Recipes, round 3: where the reloadable registries (recipes among them) are listed with their codecs, and how a load
# task reads and decodes an element's file.
calls net.minecraft.resources.RegistryDataLoader ^<clinit>$
sig net.minecraft.resources.RegistryDataLoader$RegistryData
find RegistryLoadTask
findcalls RegistryLoadTask
